char_180_amgoat.reason: Original S3 RangedAttack has empty animKey, waitForAttackEvent1 and preDelay0. Native AnimationController asks Skill_Begin/Loop/End; pinned original default Front has Skill_Start/Loop/End with no attack event, and Back has no skill clips. No source event or executable dispatcher resolves S3 release timing. Complete Eyjafjalla kit remains unsupported rather than supplying guessed attack events or a partial full kit.
char_180_amgoat.status: Historical hold; new reviewed kit uses explicitly bounded S3 immediate-release mapping. Original missing event evidence is retained, not declared recovered.

interpretations: Aroma, Ifrit, Mostima and Ceobe implement every original selected skill and promotion/potential talent. All eleven selected skills retain all ten original Global ranks. Eyjafjalla source is preserved but her full kit is deferred. Optional modules are not applied. Original Unity effects and recorded-client C# frame parity remain unverified.

Aroma/Ifrit ordinary attacks are source MeleeAttack with all-target line selectors and original facing Attack events. The runtime picks each current eligible line occupant once at release, without creating a splash per initial victim. Source line-tile range body intersections follow the existing standard-stage target selector; exact engine-side numeric selector ties and animation dispatch are unrecovered.

Aroma talent ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE first creates a derived per-enemy mark, applies native LEVITATE and scales that first output. The marker is retained for that deployment and removed on caster withdrawal/death, while nonderived levitation keeps its own lifetime/immunity/weight rules. S1 is a charged all-line attack followed by its original active buff firstTriggerInterval .1; FLY_ONLY is read after main-hit levitation, so an initially grounded levitated victim can receive the separate aerial hit. Extra damage is current source ATK and persists after release.

Aroma S2 mode is ATK ADDITION percentage plus .1s periodic in-range LEVITATE marker. The marker is derived and removed on range/eligibility loss or skill end. A marked target transitioning out of levitation while still legal in range receives one current-ATK landing hit. Marker ownership is represented by simulator source keys; duplicate same-operator native override ordering is not asserted.

Ifrit RES aura uses independentCharacterSource1 and MAGIC_RESISTANCE FINAL_SCALER with selected negative reduction converted to multiplier1+value. It checks normal target-free legality, updates range occupants and removes its own aura on departure. Output-hit refresh occurs before mitigation to handle same-frame movement. E2 second talent periodic_sp waits the selected6/5.5s, adds selected2 SP with ordinary noSp gating and never creates starting SP.

Ifrit S2 uses explicit waitForAttackEvent0, timeMode1/preDelay1.25 instead of the unrelated normal Attack event. Runtime treats this as a fixed1.25s release deadline; native timeMode/animation cap interaction remains unrecovered. Each legal line victim receives the selected independent DEF addition and a1s Arts burn interval through selected3.01s lifetime, plus exactly one main strike. Burn survives source withdrawal and reads current source ATK per AdvancedApplyDamage forceUseProjectileCachedAtkfalse interpretation.

Ifrit S3 and Mostima S2 preserve source ContinuousMeleeAttack triggerDelta1, explicit ALL/WALK selectors,1s selected debuff lifetimes and native first begin OnAttack event (IfritFront.4,Back/Down.333; Mostima.567). Later damage ticks are fixed1s and do not scale with ASPD. Ifrit own HP loss is selected MaxHP ratio each1s, PURE/skipModifierEvent/ignoreForSp, independent of target existence. Unfired startup is cancelled by observed brief control; fired continuous ticks skip unable-to-act periods without accumulating missed hits. Native FSM interruption/retry and animation-controller scheduling remain explicitly unverified.

Mostima normal direct MeleeAttack selects source radius1.1 around its primary, with no projectile; S3 direct attack uses the current expanded all-target selector and native relative knockback with selected force. Mostima caster-only global spRecover joins the existing highest-source channel used by Ptilopsis, so only the largest applicable named recovery rate applies. Source ally legality and hidden/disappeared native selector execution remain bounded by that shared adapter.

Mostima E2 move-speed aura uses named FINAL_SCALER1+negative reduction, multiplied by talent_scale for selected S3. Its ignoreTargetFree1 validator reaches living in-range hidden/untargetable occupants rather than selecting an attack victim; physically disappeared entity dispatch is unrecovered and explicitly not asserted. Ordinary Sluggish remains a separate status channel.

Ceobe source projectiles fly at10 for ordinary/S1/S3 and12 for S2. Source OnAttack caps1 are retained. S1 binds the selected unblocked-first victim; S2 uses BASE_ATTACK_TIME FINAL_SCALER and highest-DEF priority; S3 uses Physical output, lowest-DEF priority, selected expanded range and silence duration. Its additive active talent applies separate Arts damage based on current victim DEF at impact even during Physical S3, as described by the pinned Global talent. DamageViaAttr source/getAttrFromTarget context is not executable-recovered; this victim-DEF binding is explicitly description corroborated. No talent recursion is synthesized.

Ceobe E2 conditional self ATK/ASPD uses the source Manhattan min2 checker interpreted as no other living allied unit within distance1. Tokens/operators count; diagonal units do not. Exact checker occupancy/isolation/disappeared rules remain unrecovered. Skill begin/end source clips use their own mode presentation/locks, without copying another operator model or inventing absent Spine events.

Original NORMAL damage origin is retained for Aroma aerial/landing extras, Ifrit S3, Mostima S2 and Ceobe DEF talent; Immolation remains BUFF damage and own HP loss bypasses attack receipts. Aroma detached talent cannot recreate its derived first-hit marker after withdrawal, while a previously emitted nonderived aerial buff keeps its own delayed damage. Mostima relative knockback uses inherited discrete, weight-aware push with the default distance column; native travel/column classification is unrecovered, so continuous displacement and recorded-client frame parity are not asserted.
